R7AA-duck-backcountry-0001.name: Unnamed wetland 410 m N of Tsetzi Creek
R7AA-duck-backcountry-0001.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).

evidence.t: About 45 wetlands within 2 km (estimate): ducks move between them.
Beside Tsetzi Creek: backwater or oxbow (estimate).

flags.t: Spot is inside an ATV (all terrain vehicle) for Hunting Closed Area: North Chilcotin. Closed September 1 to November 30. Synopsis map 4-3/23.

seasonRows.notes: District 5. Within the 8 a day: 4 northern pintails, 4 canvasbacks, 2 Barrow's or common goldeneyes together, 2 harlequins. Possession 24: 12, 12, 6, 6.

plan: Drive: from District of Vanderhoof, about 167 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 53.02514, -124.98537, pull off on Ootsa 9620 (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 7.5 km S, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 319 m, about 182 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 120 m N of the spot at 1,173 m (52.95904, -124.97891). Water: unnamed wetland 120 m S (estimate).
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 5-12, Region 5. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-06, closures 2026-10-16.
R7AA-duck-backcountry-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 5-12: about 2,239 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.22 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
